about: The campaign's MESSAGES (the M of POEMS): every phrase the page and the mock-ups share, and the mock-ups' own. Change a phrase here and rebuild: the page (`npm run build`) and all four mock-ups (`npm run build:mockups`) carry it. Public. The offer is not here: it is data/offers.json. `event_line` is a list of parts, joined with a middle dot. In `from_price`, {price} is replaced with the lowest price per meal of the plans the page shows (data/plans.json). `handoff` is the cart hand-off's progress screen on the store's order page (SPEC-rung2-progress-and-checkout.md § 2), inlined by `npm run build:storefront` (never by `npm run build`): its title, the step line after each meal is added ({meal} the meal as its card shows it, {n} the meals added so far, {total} the plan's meals), and the line at the store's CHECKOUT. `chefs_choice` is this week's Chef's Choice on the plan page's result card (SPEC-chefs-choice.md § 3), read by `npm run build` only when a week in data/picks/ is open (without one the page does not change): `open` the button that opens the list, `heading` the list's heading ({count} the meals a week, {date} the delivery Sunday as the offer writes dates), `meal_qty` a meal chosen more than once ({meal} its name, {n} how many), `note` the line under the list, `checkout` the link to the store's checkout, `own` the plain link to the plan's order page. The build refuses a missing phrase or placeholder. ⚠ Its words are PLACEHOLDERS for the Advisor's copy review (`status`).
